scope: Reported expired-signing UI bug; no human signature or blockchain transaction submitted by these checks.
checks: At the exact expiry boundary, pending approval becomes expired; recorded approvals remain recorded.
An expired request is rejected before any wallet provider call.
Actual expired request in Brave shows disabled connect, consent and sign controls.
Expiry feedback is beside the controls and the fresh-approval link returns to local setup.
Seven focused signature/handoff checks and wallet HTTP boundaries pass.
